narrative.northStar: El isotipo original da la bienvenida
narrative.overview: Professional, friendly, playful and creative, with generous white space, rounded heavy lettering and solid color fields. Preserve the supplied original isotipo and the restrained visual language confirmed for proposal C.
keyCharacteristics: Original isotipo, unchanged in color and proportions.
Navy reading color, white space and flat brand-color fields.
Solid rounded controls and a single restrained entrance.
dos: Do preserve the original isotipo, exact brand palette and locally bundled rounded type.
Do keep focus visible and native links and disclosures operable.
Do preserve reduced-motion handling and the single restrained entrance.
donts: Don't introduce shadows, gradients or invented components into this documented system.
Don't treat superseded hero declarations as the final responsive values.
Don't turn this landing's approved composition into a universal layout requirement.
